Definition
[Palais--Smale condition] 1. ch8:8.5.1-def-4\group Critical Point Theory A functional $I \in C^1(H;\R )$ satisfies the Palais–Smale compactness condition if each sequence $\{ u_k\} _{k=1}^\infty \subset H$ such that

(i) $\{ I[u_k]\} _{k=1}^\infty $ is bounded

and

(ii) $I'[u_k] \to 0$ in $H$,

is precompact in $H$.
